title: Couette-Poiseuille flow with backflow (analytic)
description:
Steady flow in a periodic channel between a fixed wall (y_lo) and a wall sliding at U_wall along +x (y_hi), with a body force G along x (an imposed pressure gradient -dp/dx = G).
Analytic: u_x = U y/H + G y (H - y) / (2 mu); with the shape factor P = G H^2 / (2 mu U): mean u = U (1/2 + P/6), and the flow reverses next to the fixed wall for P < -1 (an adverse gradient).
Line profile tab: u_profile (u_x across the channel; shows the base P_shape = -2 with its backflow region).
Derived values tab: u_probe (u_x at y = H/4 + dx/2, exact up to ~1e-6) and u_mean (mean u_x; the cell-centre average of the parabola overshoots by (dx/H)^2/2 of the parabolic part, ~2.5e-3 at P = -2).
Sweep tab: u_probe and u_mean versus P_shape (-1.5..3) with the dashed lines probe_vs_P and mean_vs_P.

parameters.name: mu_f
parameters.description: dynamic viscosity of the liquid in Pa s

parameters.name: L_ch
parameters.description: length of the periodic cell along x (any length: the flow is uniform in x)

parameters.name: U_wall
parameters.description: speed of the upper wall along +x in m/s

parameters.name: P_shape
parameters.description: pressure-gradient shape factor P = G H^2 / (2 mu U) (> 0 favourable, < -1 backflow); swept

parameters.name: G_drive
parameters.description: body force density along x in N/m^3 (= -dp/dx)

parameters.name: y_probe
parameters.description: probe height: a cell centre near the quarter height

parameters.name: u_probe_ref
parameters.description: analytic u_x at the probe in m/s
